description: How to place, cancel and claim SMX testnet orders from your own wallet on Base Sepolia. This server never signs or sends: smx_build_order, smx_build_cancel and smx_build_claim return the unsigned transactions for you to sign; this guide returns the exact steps, contract addresses, order rules and the claim-before-cancel safety rule. Free, no key.

id.description: Optional market id; fills in that market's order book address.
